texts: 净化可以移除以下类型的减益效果：（控制效果：）（强制行动）（困倦与昏睡）（晕眩（悬浮））（晕眩被移除时，悬浮的伪击飞效果也会被移除。）（召唤师技能：）（不会移除重伤减益效果。）
尽管清晰术无法在召唤师峡谷中使用，但可以通过启封的秘籍获得。
致命一击只会对英雄生命值降至40%以下后造成的伤害触发。
无法施放技能时，标记和冲刺均无法使用。（被击飞或被禁锢时无法使用冲刺，但仍可使用标记。）
要塞强化期间，防御塔最后一击击杀敌方英雄或协助击杀敌方英雄时，会像是由你造成伤害一样为你提供助攻和击杀。此效果不适用于小兵击杀。
使用者死亡时，守护者无法触发。
在无法使用守卫的模式中，深入守卫会替换为可怖纪念品。
治疗术与复苏搭配时，会额外提供随等级提升的治疗效果；生命值低于最大生命值的40%时，该效果会提升至随等级提升的数值。

调节带来的属性提升并非全部计为额外护甲或魔法抗性。（基础护甲和魔法抗性提高的3%不计为额外护甲/魔法抗性；将鼠标悬停在护甲或魔法抗性属性上时，信息提示面板也不会将其显示为玩家基础护甲/魔法抗性的提升。因此，信息提示中的数值不会正确相加。）（由于游戏中没有基础护甲和魔法抗性比例相关的机制，无法确定基础抗性属性提高的3%应计为基础护甲/魔法抗性还是额外护甲/魔法抗性。类似的过度生长则会将其计为前者。）
英雄回城时，艾黎也会出现并播放回城动画。（此时艾黎拥有独立的1350视野半径；如果玩家回城的位置非常靠近草丛且面朝特定方向，艾黎偶尔可以看到草丛内部。）
公理秘术会影响使用者终极技能的伤害型被动效果。（瑞兹终极技能的被动“瑞兹曲境折跃”虽然属于伤害效果，但似乎不会使EQ（法术涌动 + 超负荷）伤害提高12%或8%。）
黑暗收割会对分身触发，但不会对僵尸触发。
余震会造成范围伤害，此外还带有触发效果标签，因此会施加法术特效。
请注意，如果附近有两个攻城小兵，晋升会施放在距离最近的那个身上，无论它是否已经被晋升。这可能会导致晋升浪费在已经晋升过的攻城小兵身上。
【防御塔奖励】全队所有英雄都会获得全局奖励。
如果定身效果施加给了具有位移免疫的目标，冰川增幅不会触发。
惩戒及其升级形态造成触发伤害，因此不会触发法术特效。
冲击指示器的半径为175单位，供参考。
在无法使用守卫的模式中，每层永久提供3点召唤师技能急速，最多54点。
迅捷步法不会对守卫或野区植物消耗。

先逼出风暴之怒 E 风暴之眼，再寻找没有护盾的目标。风暴之怒用掉 Q 飓风呼啸或 R 复苏季风后，从草丛或视野外寻找用魂锁典狱长 Q 死亡判决进场的角度。贴近后，用留好的一次普攻和魂锁典狱长 E 厄运钟摆进行短暂换血。

由于英雄属性只会定期更新，移动速度加成在控制效果结束（或被移除）后最多还会持续0.25秒。
脱离战斗5秒后，无情猎手会立即生效。
冥火之触造成触发伤害，并被标记为持续伤害，但不会施加法术效果。

征服者的层数每个施法实例最多只能叠加一次。（例如，凯尔的登神长阶所产生的火焰波与触发它的普通攻击属于同一施法实例，因此每次攻击只能触发一层征服者，而非预期的两层。）（每次命中都会产生独立施法实例的技能仍会正常叠加多层。）（此外，盖伦的审判和齐天大圣的腾云突击已被特别设定为每次伤害跳数均可叠加征服者。）（其他类似效果没有此特别设定，例如不屈之枪的圣盾打击、岩雀的石穿、扎克的动感弹球。）（普通攻击的基础命中特效无论施法实例如何，均可多次叠加；但无极剑圣是唯一一个因属于单一施法实例且不属于基础伤害，而无法多次叠加的多段命中特效。）（如果铁铠冥魂通过破灭之锤或断魂一扼触发黑暗起兮，该效果会被视为与触发技能属于同一施法实例，因此不会叠加征服者。）

致命节奏的弹体造成触发伤害，因此不会触发法术效果。
触发强攻第三层的那次普通攻击不会享受伤害提升。

[策略] 当守卫被摧毁、持续时间结束或被替换时，会留下守卫残骸，持续5分钟。可借此了解敌方布置守卫的习惯。

征服者在同一次施法中只能叠加一次。（例如，凯尔被动产生的火焰波与触发它的普攻属于同一次施法，因此每次攻击只能叠加一层征服者，而不是预期的两层。）（每次命中都被视为独立施法的技能，仍会正常叠加多层。）（此外，盖伦 E 和孙悟空 R 经过特殊处理，每次造成伤害时都能叠加征服者。）（其他类似效果没有受到特殊处理，例如潘森 E、岩雀 Q、扎克 R。）（无论是否属于同一次施法，附带普攻伤害的攻击特效都可以多次叠加；易大师 Q 是唯一不会多次叠加的多次触发攻击特效，因为它属于同一次施法，且造成的不是普攻伤害。）（如果莫德凯撒被动由莫德凯撒 Q 或莫德凯撒 E 触发，就会被视为与触发它的技能属于同一次施法，因此不会叠加征服者。）
该召唤师技能会增大你的英雄模型。
致命节奏的飞弹造成特效伤害，因此不会触发技能特效。
触发强攻第三层效果的那次普攻不会获得伤害提升。
守护者系列装备不算作传奇装备，因此不会触发返现。
先攻在触发时即进入冷却。
造成特效伤害的效果不会叠加一层，除非该伤害同时带有宠物伤害标签。（如果此类效果施加减益状态，例如黑色切割者的效果，仍可叠加一层。）

texts: 天启者 Q 心灵烈焰有减速和范围伤害，站在小兵后面或射程外躲开。若被天启者 R 梵咒强化的 Q 火焰圆圈命中，要在片刻后爆炸前走出圆圈。被天启者 W 坚定不移连上时，在禁锢生效前拉开距离，切断连接。
先提高魔法抗性，应对天启者的主要伤害。如果天启者 R 梵咒强化的 W 回复效果很强，就在核心装备之间补一件死刑宣告。
等天启者 W 坚定不移用掉，趁她上前补刀时用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近。若天启者 R 梵咒强化的 E 护盾已开启，就等护盾持续时间结束再进场。开始换血后，用普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末，再撤出。
刀锋之影手短，别先上前；先用刀锋之影 W 斩草除根消耗血量。不要滥用 W，以免击杀机会出现时没有足够的法力值。
能确保命中时，先用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再在近距离让刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的去程和回程都命中，接普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末。要快速打出时，先扔刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在回程前一刻用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近并接普攻。
趁天启者 W 坚定不移用掉后的空档进场，被禁锢留住的风险会降低。等天启者 E 鼓舞的移速加成和天启者 R 梵咒强化的 E 护盾结束，再用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交拉近距离。尽量留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭用于撤离。
学会刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭后，爆发和游走能力增强。推线后用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道翻墙，支援边路。游戏越往后，刀锋之影的影响力越低，因此有优势时要持续施压。
等天启者 W 坚定不移用掉、天启者 R 梵咒强化的 E 护盾结束后再进场。选定一名目标集中使用技能；若难以正面进场，就用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕到侧面，寻找后排目标。尽量在撤离时使用刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭。
解脱者 E 潜掠 / 强掳的第一段突进没有伤害，但被随后发出的锁链命中会被击飞，遭到连续攻击。刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交或刀锋之影 E 刺客之道要留到躲锁链时使用，而不是用来躲第一段突进。解脱者 Q 锁链鞭击的交叉点会延迟爆炸，即使只被第一段擦到，也要立刻离开。
为应对解脱者 W 弑君突刺的回复，在核心装备之间补一件死刑宣告。刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血伤害会持续生效，容易维持重伤效果。应对解脱者主要伤害需要的是魔法抗性，不是护甲。
解脱者上前补刀时，用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，短暂换血。在近距离让刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的两段伤害都命中，再用普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末后撤出。若解脱者 W 弑君突刺还在，要注意别只压低他的血量却迟迟不收掉。
刀锋之影 W 斩草除根耗蓝较高，不要滥用。推线后确认视野，再去游走。
能确保命中时，先用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再在近距离扔出刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，让去程和回程都命中，随后用一次普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血。要快速打出时，先扔刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在回程前一刻用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再接普攻。
躲开解脱者 E 潜掠 / 强掳第二段的锁链，且解脱者 W 弑君突刺也用掉后，就是进场机会。趁机用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，或用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道拉近距离。刀锋之影 E 刺客之道可能被锁链打断，因此要留到躲开锁链后再用；刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭则留作撤离手段。
学会刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭后，游走和爆发能力增强，要用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道在边路制造人数优势。游戏越往后，刀锋之影的影响力越低，因此有优势时要持续施压。
解脱者用解脱者 E 潜掠 / 强掳进场后、用解脱者 W 弑君突刺回复前最脆弱，此时与队友集火。自己进场时，等对方把控制技能交给队友，再用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道从侧面绕入，对一名目标集中使用技能。留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭的隐身用于撤离会更安全。

等天启者 W 坚定不移用掉后，趁天启者上前补刀时用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近。若天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾已开启，就等持续时间结束后再进场。开始换血后，用普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末，然后撤退。
刀锋之影射程较短，所以不要先手上前，用刀锋之影 W 斩草除根消耗对方血量。不要滥用 W，以免浪费本可留到击杀机会时使用的法力。
想稳妥命中时，先用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再在近距离命中刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的去程和回程攻击，接着普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末。想快速打出连招时，先施放刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在其返回前用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近并接普攻。
趁天启者 W 坚定不移冷却时进场，被禁锢的风险会降低。等天启者 E 鼓舞的移速加成和天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾结束，再用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交拉近距离。尽可能留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭，脱身时再用。
学会刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭后，爆发和游走能力都会增强，因此推线后用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道翻墙支援边路。游戏越往后，刀锋之影的影响力越低，所以优势时要继续施压。
等天启者 W 坚定不移用掉、天启者 R 梵咒强化后的 E 护盾结束后再进场。选定一名目标集中施放技能；若难以正面切入，就用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕侧面，瞄准后排。尽可能留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭，用于脱身。
解脱者 E 潜掠 / 压制的第一次突进没有伤害，但被后续锁链命中会被击飞并遭到连招。用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交或刀锋之影 E 刺客之道躲锁链时再施放，不要对着第一次突进使用。解脱者 Q 锁链鞭击的交叉点会延迟爆炸，即使被第一段擦中，也要立刻离开。
为应对解脱者 W 弑君突刺的回复，在核心装备之间补出死刑宣告。刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血会持续造成伤害，容易维持重伤效果。应对解脱者主要伤害时需要的是魔法抗性，而非护甲。
趁解脱者上前补刀时用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，进行短暂换血。在近距离命中刀锋之影 W 斩草除根的两段攻击后，普攻触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末并撤退。若解脱者 W 弑君突刺还在，就只消耗他的血量，注意不要拖到他用 W 回复后才尝试收尾。
刀锋之影 W 斩草除根耗蓝较多，不要滥用；推完线后注意视野，再进行游走。
想稳妥命中时，先用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再在近距离施放刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，命中其往返攻击，接着普攻一次触发刀锋之影 P 刀锋之末的流血。想快速打出连招时，先施放刀锋之影 W 斩草除根，在其返回前用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，再接普攻。
躲开解脱者 E 潜掠 / 压制的第二段锁链，并等解脱者 W 弑君突刺也进入冷却后再进场。抓住空档用刀锋之影 Q 诺克萨斯式外交贴近，或用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道拉近距离。刀锋之影 E 刺客之道可能被锁链打断，所以等躲开锁链后再用；留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭脱身。
学会刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭后，游走和爆发能力会增强，因此用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道支援边路，制造人数优势。游戏越往后，刀锋之影的影响力越低，所以优势时要继续施压。
解脱者刚用 E 潜掠 / 压制突进后、还没来得及用 W 弑君突刺回复时最弱，和队友一起集火。亲自切入时，等敌方控制技能交给队友后，用刀锋之影 E 刺客之道绕侧面，集中技能攻击一名目标。稳妥起见，留着刀锋之影 R 暗影突袭的隐身效果，用于脱身。

texts: Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, making follow-up damage likely. If you’re hit by the first spell, use LeBlanc W Distortion immediately to reposition and dodge the second. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on your maximum health, so leave the telegraphed area.
Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.

After Hwei uses E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave, use LeBlanc W Distortion to close the gap. Deal brief damage, check which retaliation spells Hwei still has, then escape by recasting W to return.

While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, don’t engage first with LeBlanc W Distortion. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you can’t push the lane, don’t leave.
Once Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and stay in range to keep the chain connected.

Hwei has no mobility spell, so engage with LeBlanc W Distortion while Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If E is still available, Hwei can stop your engage or root you, so wait. Before going in, make sure your W return point is safe.

Early, withstand Hwei’s magic damage with magic resistance and take short trades. Later, the enemy’s magic resistance and vision can prevent you from killing them in one burst and leave you open to retaliation, so prioritize opportunities to catch someone out.

Don’t engage first from the front. Once a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, approach from the side. When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, use LeBlanc W Distortion on one backline target, then escape by recasting W to return. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy moving alone in an area without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

Sylas E Abscond / Abduct: the chains he throws after the first dash are more dangerous than the dash itself. Save LeBlanc W Distortion to dodge those chains, and immediately leave the crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash. Sylas can heal a lot with W Kingslayer when low, so don’t delay finishing him off.
Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Trade briefly after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is used, before it comes back. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion, watch whether Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, then escape by recasting LeBlanc W Distortion to return.
Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, then roam. If you can’t push the lane, don’t leave.

When Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep the chain connected. As soon as the root lands, use LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion to trigger the mark. Before engaging, make sure your return point is safe, and recast LeBlanc W Distortion in time to return.

After dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, that’s your window to engage before the spell comes back. Check whether Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, since he can use it to escape, then engage with LeBlanc W Distortion. Get out before LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window expires.
Later, once the enemy has magic resistance and vision, it becomes hard to kill them in one burst, so avoid forcing an engage.

Right after Sylas dives in with E Abscond / Abduct, root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or R Mimic and kill him before he can heal with W Kingslayer. When engaging yourself, wait until the fight starts, target one backline enemy from the side, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Also look for a chance to catch an enemy moving alone without vision with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and move out of its path as it returns, too. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if he’s low.
Survive early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and LeBlanc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.

Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area and take a short trade right after Ekko E Phase Dive is used. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and look for a chance to root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. Before engaging, make sure LeBlanc W Distortion’s return point is safe.

Avoid trading head-on before the enemy’s key spells are down. Repeat short trades by engaging with LeBlanc W Distortion and recasting it to return. Clear the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, push the lane, then join a side lane or jungle skirmish. If you can’t push the lane, don’t leave.

A safe short trade goes: mark the target with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, trigger it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return. If Ekko E Phase Dive is down, hit LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and keep it connected; when the root lands, follow with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice → LeBlanc W Distortion. To try for another root, cast LeBlanc R Mimic immediately after LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s marked area and engage after Ekko E Phase Dive is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. When both mobility spells are down, approach with LeBlanc W Distortion and connect LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Early, build magic resistance and trade briefly only when the enemy’s key spells are down. Later, avoid forcing an engage, since you can be punished if you fail to kill them in one burst.

Don’t engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, then choose a target and approach from the side. Right after Ekko engages with E Phase Dive, try to root him with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic, then escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Before a teamfight, also look for a chance to catch an enemy moving alone with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.

If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends so the second dagger doesn’t hit. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so use your finishing spell after it ends. Don’t roam alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is ready.

Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first and get health as well. If fights drag on because of healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate, consider anti-heal next.

Take short trades only right after Naafiri’s key mobility spell is used. Mark her with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, trigger it with LeBlanc W Distortion, then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return before she can retaliate. Before engaging, make sure your return point is safe.

Naafiri is melee, so farm and poke from behind your minion line. Don’t give her an angle to engage with Naafiri E Eviscerate. After Naafiri E Eviscerate, which revives her pack, is down, look for a chance to clear the pack with LeBlanc W Distortion’s area damage. If you push the wave with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, join a side lane or jungle skirmish.
Then recast LeBlanc W Distortion to return to a safe spot.

Engage during the window after Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate are down, and before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. Close the gap with LeBlanc W Distortion and bind her escape route with LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is still available, retreat within the brief window when LeBlanc W Distortion can return you.
Early, use LeBlanc’s range advantage to poke Naafiri. Later, failing to kill an enemy in one burst makes retaliation dangerous, so prioritize chances to catch someone moving alone.

Don’t engage first from the front. Wait until a fight starts and the enemy focuses on your allied tank, then choose a target and approach from the side. Target one backline enemy and escape with LeBlanc W Distortion. Be wary of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, stay with your allies instead of roaming alone, and retreat right after an ally dies so you aren’t caught in a chain of picks.

texts: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid being hit. If you’re hit by the fiery circle from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move out of it before it explodes a moment later. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break it before you’re rooted.
Build magic resistance early against Karma’s primary damage. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W is strong, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.

After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Karma steps forward to last-hit. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, delay your engage until it expires. Once you start trading, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack and disengage.
Talon has short range, so don’t walk forward first; use Talon W Rake to chip away at their health. Don’t spam W and run out of mana you need for a kill opportunity.

For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then land both the outward and returning hits of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with a basic attack.

Engaging during the window when Karma W Focused Resolve is down reduces the risk of being rooted. Wait for the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E to expire, then close the distance with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to use when disengaging.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your burst and roaming power increase, so push the wave and use Talon E Assassin's Path to cross walls and influence side lanes. Talon’s impact falls off as the game goes longer, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.

Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E has expired. Choose one target and focus your abilities on them. If engaging from the front is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the backline. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.

The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but if the follow-up chains hit you, they knock you up and let him chain attacks. Time Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to dodge the chains, not the first dash. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash detonates late, so move away immediately even if you’re grazed by the initial hit.

Fit Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. The bleed from Talon P Blade's End deals damage over time, making it easy to keep healing reduction applied. The resistance that counters Sylas’s main damage is magic resistance, not armor.

When Sylas steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy for a short trade. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack and disengage. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, be careful not to leave him low and delay finishing him.
Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana, so don’t spam it. After pushing the wave, check vision as you roam.

For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range to land both hits. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the bleed from Talon P Blade's End. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with a basic attack.

Dodge the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Your opportunity to engage comes when Sylas W Kingslayer is also down. Use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy to close in or Talon E Assassin's Path to get closer during that window. Talon E Assassin's Path can be interrupted by the chains, so save it until you’ve dodged them, and keep Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst become stronger, so use Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage on the side lanes. Talon’s impact falls off as the game goes longer, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.

Right after Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, he is at his weakest before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer, so focus him down with your allies. When engaging yourself, wait until the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. It’s safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.

texts: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid it. If you are hit by the flame circle from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame, leave the circle before it explodes a moment later. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away to break it before the root takes hold.
Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W Focused Resolve is strong, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.

After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy to close in when Karma steps forward for a last hit. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire is active, delay your engage until it expires. Once you start the trade, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then back off.
Talon has short range, so avoid stepping forward first and chip away at Karma's health with Talon W Rake. Do not use it so often that you lack mana for a kill opportunity.

When you can reliably land the combo, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then land both the outward and returning hits of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with a basic attack.

Engaging while Karma W Focused Resolve is down reduces the risk of being caught by its root. Wait for the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire to expire, then close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon's burst and roaming become stronger. Push the wave, then cross walls with Talon E Assassin's Path to influence a side lane. Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has expired. Pick one target and focus your abilities on them. If engaging from the front is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the backline. If possible, use Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.

The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but the follow-up chain knocks you up and leaves you open to a combo if it hits. Time Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to dodge the chain, rather than the first dash. The crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so leave it immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.

Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. The bleed from Talon P Blade's End deals damage over time, making it easy to maintain Grievous Wounds. Build magic resistance, rather than armor, against Sylas's main damage.

When Sylas steps forward for a last hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy for a short trade. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then back off. If Sylas W Kingslayer is available, be careful not to leave him at low health and delay the finish.
Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana, so do not overuse it. After pushing the wave, check vision as you roam.

When you can reliably land the combo, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then throw Talon W Rake at close range to land both hits. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the bleed from Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then basic attack.

Your chance to engage comes after you dodge the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct and Sylas W Kingslayer is also down. Use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to close the gap. The chain can interrupt Talon E Assassin's Path, so save it until you have dodged the chain, and keep Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.

After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon's roaming and burst become stronger. Use Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage in a side lane. Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

Sylas is most vulnerable just after engaging with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer, so focus him with your team. When engaging yourself, wait until the enemy has used crowd control on your allies, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. It is safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
